hypothesis: Bounded durable async execute/verify/eligibility stages resume committed step state after worker SIGKILL without duplicate effective steps or completions; group authentication and strict on-policy admission remain enforced.
cheaper_gate: Step-boundary, fencing, persistence rollback, authentication, partial-group, staleness and independent-stage regression tests, then 100-trajectory paired screen.
duration_distribution: Deterministic per-ID Pareto(alpha=1.5) asyncio.sleep, min(0.02,0.0005*x) per step; step counts min(64,2+floor(2*Pareto(alpha=1.4))) per group.
sync_baseline: Same eight execute workers and two verify workers, persistence/signing/admission. Producer waits for each cohort of eight trajectories to be acknowledged before enqueueing the next; async keeps a bounded continuous backlog.
faults: One actual worker SIGKILL after first committed step in each paired case; stale-worker message after recovery; duplicate group acknowledgments every 128 groups. Other deterministic falsification cases are separate regression tests.
timing: Real wall clock, including enrollment, fault child startup/kill/lease wait, verification and admission. Snapshot backup/offline audit excluded. No warmup excluded.
acceptance: 100% declared trajectories consumed, exact declared step count, valid streamed audit, zero duplicated effective commits, all injected stale/duplicate commits rejected. No throughput improvement required.
abort: 20 minutes per case, 1 GiB SQLite page budget; do not proceed from Stage A to B on a correctness failure. Preserve failed outputs.
spend: CPU only on existing host; no model/API/cloud spend.
decision: If correctness passes, retain the single-host runtime and its measured limits; otherwise fix the concrete failing boundary before scaling. Stage D requires a separately qualified task/evaluator.
supersedes: v1 remains retained; re-review exposed missing behavior-distribution/prompt-token admission guards and missing quarantine audit coverage.
behavior_contract: Deterministic synthetic counter policy; model/source identity, T=1 and recognized distribution are explicit. Conditioned prompt IDs [0,counter] identify its one supported action with probability 1 (logprob 0). No neural inference or optimizer is simulated as learning.
